item.tib: 'chi med mgon po tshe dpag med kyi sgrub pa las dbang don rdo rje sgeg pa o rgyan sangs rgyas gling pas mdzad pa
item.coloph: 'chi med rdo rje go khrab dbang don sngon du 'gro ba'i tshul 'di ni/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje gsang mdzod nang du btus nas 'chad bde go sla phyi rabs rjes 'breng gi don du lhag bsam dge ba'i ma 'ongs snyigs dus kyi mtha' yas 'gro ba the tshom che zhing dbang bskur byin rlabs 'jug dka' ba 'dug pas/ de la yid ches nges shes rnyed pa'i lo rgyus zhig med na mi yong ba 'dra ba la/ rtsa rgyud rdo rje gsang mdzod kho na ru klog kyang le'u gsum po yang / man ngag rtsa ba'i gsang rgyud du song ba'i (bas) dbang skabs su 'chad mi bde zhing / ma rig theg dman rnams kyis don rtsa mi go ba bcas/ kun rtog yid kyi rab rib sel phyir rtsa rgyud gzhung las bstan zhing tshig gi brjod bde tsam ma gtogs gter phyung kho na ru yin no/ yig mgo a shad dang gter tshag byed pa yang de'i gnad yin no/ 'chi med tshe'i sgrub rdo rje go khrab dbang chog rdo rje 'phring ('phreng) ba'i dbang don rdo rje sgeg pa kho bo sangs rgyas gling pas Dak+ki 'du gling la mau shel brag nas sbyar ba'o//
